notes.title: Recent Update Plan
notes.content:
The new character : Huntress.
Skills system and talents tree are all new.
New game items and stages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/f23a126007933ef1408ef25078ff244a7841efe5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tutorial level is already available
notes.content:
1. Added tutorial level
  Due to the complexity of the game system, it is not intuitive for novices to communicate the system design. We have created tutorial level. If you play for the first time, you will automatically enter the teaching levels at the beginning. Otherwise, you can select "Tutorial" from the main menu to enter.
2. Fixed the issue of price detection when purchasing a single item.
3. Adjusted the value of some remote skills.
4. Adjust the volume of background music in some scenes to be invalid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/c16d8964e46b4b5de08bf494176a085cdcb36b14.jpg[/img]

notes.title: patch
notes.content:
1. Fixed character parsing errors in non-English and Simplified Chinese operating systems.
2. Some interface issues

notes.title: Game controller unresponsive solution
notes.content:
If you are playing with a game controller and the controller becomes unresponsive, try the following steps, then In the game, you can set the controller key type from four presets.
1. Enter STEAM big picture mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/6e22b5336fa1dd1150e1f238433da0aa4340ffb5.jpg[/img]
2. click setting
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/f034440ec32b1a4daa2caf5829e6607052504341.jpg[/img]
3. click controller settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/411d10dd0736a52be33832da97fa728c87f72122.jpg[/img]
4. uncheck joystick support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/864a3399b242bc378ae268dabcfb2b76e49ba48a.jpg[/img]
5. restart the game

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
1. Controller player's key prompt method changed from original text to icons
2. The function of the controller's cross key has been changed from item control to player control
3. Skills value adjustment.
4. The player's initial movement speed is slightly increased

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue that village collision is invalid.
2. Skills value adjustment.
3. Added the set equipments "Wind Spike"

notes.title: Content will be updated soon
notes.content:
1. Fully support STEAM controller
As users respond to different controller prompts and do not correspond to problems, we are stepping up fully support for STEAM controller.
If there is a conflict with your controller settings before the update, please turn off the controller in the STEAM full screen mode then enter the game. There are independent controller settings in the game. As long as the controller is connected to the computer, you can play normally.
2. Detailed tutorial level
Users may have difficulty understanding the more complicated game mechanics. We are stepping up the production of tutorial levels in order to give you a clearer understanding of the game mechanics.
